image.description: If the user provided an image link, return it exactly. Otherwise return an English keyword for Wikipedia search.

items.description: ONLY include a maximum of 3 meanings that are most useful for the IELTS exam. Ignore rare or obscure definitions.

definition_vi.description: Vietnamese meaning in the format: 'nghĩa chính - giải thích'. Example: 'Hoãn - Sắp xếp để một sự kiện diễn ra vào một thời điểm hoặc ngày muộn hơn so với dự kiến ban đầu.'

patterns.description: ONLY include patterns commonly used in IELTS. Use the format: '[phrase] + [form]', e.g., 'interested in + N/V-ing'.

examples.description: 2 natural English sentences using the word in this sense. STRICT RULE: BOLD the ENTIRE phrase/pattern using Markdown **phrase** (e.g., '**proposal for**', '**proposal to**').

usage_notes_vi.description: Detailed usage notes in Vietnamese. 1. **Cách dùng:** Explain patterns/nuance with bullet points. 3. (Optional) 'Thường đi với các từ như: ...'. STRICT RULE: DO NOT include examples (Ví dụ: ...) here.

items.description: ONLY include collocations that are commonly used in the IELTS exam (Academic Writing/Speaking).

examples.description: 1-2 natural English sentences. STRICT RULE: BOLD the ENTIRE collocation using Markdown **collocation** (e.g., '**make a proposal**').

word_roots.description: Word origin and breakdown (Gốc từ và nguồn gốc từ)

origin.description: Language of origin and original word, e.g., 'tiếng Latinh cổ (impeiorare)' or 'tiếng Hy Lạp cổ (bios)'

root.description: The prefix, root, or suffix, e.g., 'in-', 'peior', '-ed'

meaning_vi.description: Vietnamese explanation of the component's meaning

mnemonic_vi.description: Association tip/mnemonic in Vietnamese to help remember the word based on its roots
